about.title: About me.
about.paragraph_1: I am a Full Stack Developer with more than 5 years of experience building scalable solutions in the fintech sector using Laravel, React, and AWS.
about.paragraph_2: My experience includes full-stack feature development, application evolution, REST API integrations, PostgreSQL query optimization, asynchronous processing with RabbitMQ, and feature deployment in AWS environments.
about.paragraph_3: Throughout my career, I have also worked on improving system usability and performance, contributing to a reduction of more than 40% in support tickets and a 25% increase in a team's operational efficiency.

experience.title: Experience.
experience.description: Professional experience developing, evolving, and maintaining web applications across different technologies and business contexts.
experience.mapipay.description: Developed full-stack features using Laravel and JavaScript, contributed to application architecture improvements, built interfaces and internal tools, implemented asynchronous processing with RabbitMQ, optimized PostgreSQL queries, and deployed features to AWS environments. Also handled critical support demands and usability improvements, contributing to a reduction of more than 40% in support tickets.
experience.gebit.description: Developed and maintained full-stack features using Laravel and JavaScript, including REST API integrations. Implemented a new reporting system that increased the team's operational efficiency by 25%, while also working on PostgreSQL query optimization, Docker, RabbitMQ, and AWS deployments.
experience.react.description: Developed dynamic dashboards with ReactJS based on user profiles, integrated applications with REST APIs, and managed version control with GitLab. Participated in client meetings to define and align features, working in an agile environment with Scrum and Jira.
experience.cyber_chain.description: Developed interfaces and dashboards using ReactJS, integrated front-end applications with REST APIs, and worked with code versioning in an agile environment using Scrum.
experience.javascript.description: Developed ReactJS components following software development best practices, collaborated on team projects using Scrum, and managed code versioning with GitLab.
